title: LightCatcher
description: The feasibility of using light source blocks in survival mode, with support for protection plugins.
body:
Supported Versions: 1.20 ~ 26.X

-> Click here to contact us for support <-

---

As a server owner, most of the light-block plugins out there just aren't great to use,
or they're stuck on outdated versions,
so we developed a light plugin built for 1.20 and above,
with Folia support — we're sure build-focused servers will love it!

--- ## 🧩 Features - Any light operation requires **holding a light source in your main hand** - Get close to a light source to see it - Left-click to break the light source - Right-click to adjust brightness (cycle up, e.g. 1 → 2 → 3) - Right-click + sneak to adjust brightness (cycle down, e.g. 3 → 2 → 1) - Supports most land-protection plugins - For example, the corresponding permission in **Residence** is `destroy` - **GriefPrevention** and **GriefDefender** are also supported - If you find a protection plugin that isn't supported, please be sure to [contact us](https://plugin.brilliantw.net/)! --- ## 📥 How to Use - Download this plugin - Drop the `plugin.jar` into your server's plugins folder (`plugins`) - Done! (If you use a plugin loader, remember to `load` the plugin) --- ## ⚙️ Configuration None — plug and play. --- ## 💬 Commands None either — plug and play. --- ## 🔓 Permissions Still none — plug and play. --- ## 🧷 Source Code [Github](https://github.com/BrilliantTeam/LightCatcher) --- ## 📢 Notice

Please do not sell plugins developed by the Brilliant Team, or sell their features.
All of our plugins are provided to servers free of charge,
so we earn no real income from developing them.

Such behavior will, to some extent, reduce our willingness to keep developing,
and may lead us to consider turning free, open-source plugins into paid, closed-source ones. We hope you understand.
